title: Self-custody and crypto-wallet usability in an unsupported ecosystem
description: Examines the usability and security challenges that novice and experienced crypto-wallet users face in Bangladesh, where self-custodial tools are used without formal institutional or regulatory support, and what this reveals about the assumptions built into wallet design.
methodology: Qualitative and quantitative user studies (interviews, surveys).

title: XR-based authentication against shoulder surfing and keystroke inference
description: Design and evaluation of virtual- and augmented-reality authentication mechanisms (AuthVR; an AR-based ATM authentication scheme) that aim to resist observation attacks while remaining usable for ordinary users.
role: Co-author; contributed to system development and evaluation.
methodology: Formal analysis and a user study (n = 30).
outcome: Published at IEEE TrustCom 2025 and in IEEE Access.

title: Why users struggle with decentralized messaging applications
description: Investigates the friction non-expert users encounter with messaging DApps—identity, addressing, and key handling—and why familiar mental models from centralized platforms break down.

title: Women's cybersecurity practices, awareness, and vulnerabilities in Bangladesh
description: Studies how women in Bangladesh navigate online safety—their everyday practices, awareness, and the vulnerabilities they encounter—to inform more context-sensitive security support.

title: Inclusive mobile financial services for low-literate users
description: Explores how smartphone-based mobile financial services can be designed so that low-literate users can move from dependence on agents toward independent, autonomous use.

title: Non-expert behaviour and attitudes toward age-verification technologies
description: Ongoing work at the HIVE Lab, Penn State, examining how non-expert users behave toward and reason about different age-verification methods, and how this shapes their perception of privacy and security.
role: Leading the study as Research Intern.
